displayName: NGA Computer Troubleshooting - PC Not Turning On Agent

scenario.task:
We are testing computer troubleshooting flows and potential transfer to agents. We need to use short utterances to navigate with your current issue.

Your opening message must be: "I need to speak to an agent about a PC that isn't turning on"

Do not reveal your intent or specific issue until the agent asks "what can I help you with". Only after being asked that question should you start interacting.
evaluationExpectations: User must be routed through computer troubleshooting skill or transferred to an agent
